Container.Name: DeepSeek-Harness
Container.Overview: DeepSeek Harness is DeepSeek AI's open-source agent harness: an AI coding agent you run in the browser. Give it a workspace and it reads and edits files, runs commands in a sandbox, keeps a session history, and schedules recurring tasks.
Container.Requires: To access the web UI for the first time, open the login link that's printed in the container's logs. This will set a session cookie that keeps your browser signed in for 30 days.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: deepseek harness dsh coding agent ai si artificial super intelligence llm developer agentic models hermes grok bot openclaw muse qwen kimi claude anthropic openai ollama

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: The published HTTP port. Change the host side only; DSH listens on 3080 inside the container.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Settings, sessions, plugins, and the saved API key.

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: The folder the agent reads and edits.

Config.Name: Home
Config.Description: The app user's home: tools the agent installs (npm -g, pip --user, uv tool), SSH keys, and configs.

Config.Name: Trusted Hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of hostnames or IPs allowed to reach the UI (e.g. 192.168.1.10,dsh.example.com).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The full URL printed in the container log as the login link (e.g. https://dsh.example.com).
